criteria.observation: For every uncovered request the plan withholds readiness for the evidenced receipt, scope, state, time or use reasons.
Current exact approvals are recognized for their covered requests; avoid unnecessary holds.
The rollback names the observed original image and replica count.
Preparation has no effect, any future execution revalidates live state and receipt, and recovery requires distinct new authority.
For each request the next role, checkable evidence and resumption condition match the actual blocker or readiness state.
